description: Declaration invariants in both forms — after a declaration's closer (with `renders` between two clauses) and after a `type :struct` body — whose literals keep them, compile and run; a function named `invariant` is still an ordinary call elsewhere.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rules 1-2: several clauses and `renders` follow the closer in either order; `invariant` is contextual only right after a closer / a `:struct` body and before `(` — "Anywhere else it is an ordinary name".
